description: The MET tower structure (mast & foundation) will be approximately 328 feet above the mean sea level.
context_quote: The overall height of the MET tower structure (mast & foundation) will be approximately 328 feet (~100 m) above the mean sea level.

description: The platform deck supporting the mast will be approximately 3,000 square feet.
context_quote: The platform deck supporting the mast will be approximately 3,000 square feet (279 square meters) with the upper access platform located at a Top of Grating (TOG) of approximately 70 feet (21.3 meters).

description: The main Caisson will be a 1.8 m diameter pile that tapers to 1.5 m diameter above the mudline.
context_quote: The main Caisson will be a 1.8 m (72 inch) diameter pile that tapers to 1.5 m (60 inch) diameter above the mudline.

description: The pile will be driven approximately 53.3 m into the seabed.
context_quote: The pile will be driven approximately 53.3 m (175 ft) into the seabed.

description: The two bracing piles will be 1.5 m diameter each.
context_quote: The two bracing piles will be 1.5 m (60 inch) diameter each.

description: The bracing piles will be driven approximately 50.6 m into the seabed.
context_quote: These piles will be driven approximately 50.6 m (166 ft) into the seabed, with a true batter of 1 in 3 (length of approximately 53.3 m [175 ft] mudline to BOS.

description: The oceanographic package will be housed in an industry standard trawl resistant bottom mount with a bottom APE of approximately 58” long x 58” wide x 21” deep.
context_quote: The sea-bed mounted oceanographic data gathering package will be housed in an industry standard trawl resistant bottom mount with a bottom APE of approximately 58” long x 58” wide x 21” deep (147 cm x 147 cm x 53 cm).

description: The oceanographic package will require 2 visits by the O&M vessel once each quarter for a 1-year period.
context_quote: The oceanographic package will require 2 visits by the O&M vessel once each quarter for a 1-year period.

description: Areas with small magnetic anomalies will be avoided during bottom-disturbing activities.
context_quote: To avoid any potential for disturbance of man-made features, the areas in which small magnetic anomalies were detected will be avoided during bottom disturbing activities.

description: A planned operations and maintenance (O&M) visit out to the MET tower is proposed once a month for 2 days duration.
context_quote: A planned operations and maintenance (O&M) visit out to the MET tower by the US Wind Baltimore based O&M contractor is proposed once a month for 2 days duration out of Ocean City MD.
